svg.title: OIDC activation: 19 of 26 source steps landed; step 20 in progress and 6 other open. Step 20 has 2/5 diagnostic groups landed and a separate 16-unit detail view.
svg.desc: Every numbered segment has a visible name and written status. Steps 01–19 are source-landed, step 20 protected token release is in progress and steps 21–26 are open. Step 19 retains five landed components. Step 20 has two landed groups: current proofs/possession/effects and metadata-only release-key custody. Consume planning/execution remains in progress; exact release and cold handoff remain open. The separate 16-unit detail expands the consume group without adding scope: 10 landed, 1 in progress, 5 other open. Row 11 private consume authorization and issuance has 12 named substeps: 8 landed, 0 in progress and 4 open. A01–A03 foundations landed in f6dd3cba33fc64670fa78c5dc1bd225b3bb54ef8; A04–A08 first-exact storage, verified export, root-controlled key/storage delivery, cold planner connection and private export service landed in 0ef6024f5d0cf56e865fa39ee767ac57739055e0. NEXT within row 11: A09 receiving-purpose key custody, then A10 independent original-proof replay, A11 consume-grant issuance and A12 cold consume-grant service. Row 11 remains in progress; rows 12–16 remain open. Group c has 8/12 landed, 1 in progress and 3 other open. No consumption execution or plaintext release is claimed. All nested counts are nonadditive. Execution remains 6/7, private replay 8/8, parent 34/46 and production acceptance 0/6 verified. Source is unbuilt and unexecuted; counts are not effort, ETA or readiness percentages.
